title: Antipodea Trainer Registry
description: The Antipodea phone for the Pokémon Westmarch: Messages, Contacts, PokéGram, Camera, Gallery, Calendar, Trainer Card and Riding Licence, with GM-voiced Rotom Phones. Tracks badges, licences, demerit points and suspensions on the Seasons & Stars world clock and posts notices to Discord.

recommends.reason: Shows in-game dates on cards and fines. The module still works off core world time without it.
